purpose: One final fixed-code generalization check after the providerLoss persistence repair. Preserve all v5 data. Do not broaden this medium-term study after this cohort.
cached_sources: Reuse the three exact original PGN byte files from generalization-candidates. No download, new source, source comments or variations.

game_rule.wch2016: Actual cached file order, ranks 7 through 12 inclusive.
game_rule.candidates2018: Ascending (numeric integer part of Round, White, Black), unchanged from v5; ranks 7 through 12 inclusive.
game_rule.wch2024: Actual cached file order, ranks 7 through 12 inclusive.
game_rule.overlap: No duplicate main-line games within these 18 or against the first-six v5 registry. Historic development exposure beyond those publicly compared registries is not established.
game_rule.parity: Within each new group of six, odd ordinal White and even ordinal Black. Source ranks 7 through 12 have the same parity.

position_rule.balance: First available pre-choice position with a fully admitted unrestricted D16 non-mate score and abs(White centipawns) <= 100.
position_rule.fallback: Keep every unbalanced, uncertified or nonexistent slot in the attempt record, then try the next fixed slot. Do not replace any game or exclude it based on post-choice evaluation.
position_rule.no_feature_filter: No SAN, tactic, capture count, product question, generated text or desired explanation type selects a game or position.

execution.completed_report: Actual frontend Protocol and exact-depth outcome guard. Entire requested multiPV at D and previous D-1 must be unbounded, legally replayable, unique at the root, and match actual bestmove; no partial-PV filtering.
execution.start: Only after the root announces v6 compile/test/source freeze and authorizes execution.
